data.rationale: Total Assets = Lending & Treasury Assets + Other Assets
Lending, Liquidity & Treasury Assets = Cash + Loans + Securities + Other
Deposits & Short-Term Funding = Deposits + Accruals + ST Funding + Due to Banks
Net Equity = Capital & Premium + Reserves + OCI
Securities & Treasury Portfolio = Amortised Cost + FVOCI + Trading & FVTPL
Total Liabilities & Equity = Deposits & Funding + Other Liabilities + Equity
Fixed, Intangible & Other Assets = Premises + Accum. Depreciation + Goodwill & Intangibles + Other
Other Liabilities = Other Financial Liabilities + Deferred Tax + Provisions
Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Debt + Equity + Dividends
Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions

data.expression: SUM(cf-ni, cf-da, cf-dar, cf-dinv, cf-dap, cf-dwc)
data.rationale: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Profit + D&A + Balance Sheet Movements
Credit Impairment & Provisions = Credit Impairment (ECL) + Provisions + Other Impairment
Depreciation & Amortisation = Premises + Leases + Software
Operating Profit = Pre-Depreciation Profit − D&A
Operating Margin % = Operating Profit / Net Operating Income x 100
Pre-Depreciation Operating Profit = GP − Administrative Expenses
Pre-Depreciation Margin % = Pre-Depreciation Profit / Net Operating Income x 100
Pre-Tax Profit = Operating Profit + Other Gains & Losses
Free Cash Flow = CFO + CapEx
Net Income after Credit Costs = Net Operating Income − Credit Impairment & Provisions
Income after Credit Costs % = GP / Net Operating Income x 100
Profit for the Year = Pre-Tax Profit − Tax
Net Profit Margin % = Profit / Net Operating Income x 100
Other Gains & Losses = Equity-Method Result + Disposals + Other
Administrative Expenses = Front Office & Distribution + Technology & Digital + Operations, Control & G&A
Net Operating Income = Gross Interest, Fee & Other Income − Interest, Fee & Other Expense
